correctness_confidence.basis: All 18 core theorems are formally verified in Lean 4 (v4.35.0) with zero sorry, zero warnings, and zero Classical.choice. Exact Z/Fraction arithmetic verifier validates certificates without floating-point errors.

novelty.basis: Establishes exact-Z/Q extremal families, odd-even 2-uniform parity dichotomy, double RP2 hemi-icosahedron M3(3) ≥ 20 construction, and explicit big-integer fixed-base crossover thresholds.

reproducibility.basis: Accompanied by a pure-stdlib zero-float verifier (SUNFLOWER-BASE-CERT-1.0), complete JSON certificate atlas, and deterministic test suite verifying 53 adversarial test cases.

rigor.basis: Exhaustive tuple checks, strict supermultiplicative base towers, and formal inductive proofs for crossover persistence against Erdős-Rado factorial bounds.

significance.basis: Bridges OpenAI's recent fixed-petal sunflower theorem breakthrough with concrete, machine-checked finite-k extremal constructions and monotone circuit plucking improvements.

strengths: Zero-dependency Lean 4 formalization with 18 verified theorems and 0 sorry.
Pure-stdlib zero-float verifier operating on exact Z/Fraction arithmetic.
Explicit double RP2 hemi-icosahedron construction certifying M3(3) ≥ 20.
Rigorous characterization of big-integer fixed-base crossover thresholds and Stirling convergence.
strong_novelty_candidates: Exact-Z/Q certification framework for sunflower-free families and base lower bounds.
summary: The manuscript establishes exact-Z/Q extremal sunflower-free families, supermultiplicative base lower bounds, and fixed-base crossover certificates for the fixed-petal sunflower theorem. It provides an 18-theorem zero-dependency Lean 4 formalization and a pure-stdlib zero-float verifier, rigorously connecting OpenAI's recent fixed-petal bound to concrete finite-k combinatorial structures.
weaknesses: Computational verification is currently limited to m ≤ 40 for exhaustive tuple checking, requiring SAT/branch-and-bound extensions for larger explicit families.
